name: Cameleer
description: An integration engine in the style of Apache Camel, written in Rust: Apache Camel's routes, Enterprise Integration Patterns, endpoint URIs and YAML DSL as one native binary with no third-party dependencies, plus MCP tools for AI agents.

install.crates: cameleer (wraps cameleer-main and forwards its features; cargo install cameleer-main works the same)
install.archives: https://github.com/cameleering/cameleer/releases (since 0.6.1: Linux x86-64, Windows x86-64, macOS arm64; each with SHA-256, CycloneDX SBOM and Sigstore bundle)

not: Apache Camel (the Java framework from the Apache Software Foundation)
affiliation: Independent; not affiliated with or endorsed by the Apache Software Foundation.

measured.version: 0.8.0 (measured on main at beb3385, identical to the release for the benchmarked paths)
measured.hardware: DigitalOcean c-4 (4 dedicated vCPUs, Xeon Platinum 8358 and 8280, sfo2), same machines for both sides

results.result: lower than Apache Camel (JVM and Quarkus native) in every scenario

results.baseline: 20,254 calls/s, 295 MB (camel-mcp-server, JVM); 2,684 calls/s, 202 MB (MCP TypeScript SDK)

losses.note: more CPU while serving 4.3x the requests
